dedupe_keys.name: ukopa pipeline fault database product loss incidents and faults report uk

description: UKOPA is a membership organisation of UK pipeline operators responsible for over 27,000 km of pipelines. Its Fault and Risk Working Group keeps a pipeline fault database and publishes a yearly Product Loss Incidents and Faults Report. The edition of November 2024 (UKOPA/RP/24/001) covers onshore Major Accident Hazard Pipelines operated by National Gas, Cadent, Northern Gas Networks, SGN, Wales and West Utilities, Gas Networks Ireland, E.ON, INEOS, Sabic, Shell and others from 1962 to 2022, with support from the Health and Safety Executive. It reports exposure, transported products, product loss incidents by cause (girth weld defects, external interference, external corrosion, stress corrosion cracking and others), ignition and detection, and part-wall fault data with statistical distributions of defect dimensions for estimating failure probability from external interference. The overall failure frequency for 1962 to 2022 was 0.194 incidents per 1,000 km-years, falling to 0.042 for the last five years. Coverage is national. The report is a free PDF but copyright UKOPA, with reproduction only by written approval. Caveats: the data are aggregate, and the event database itself is not public. The report supports failure rate and fragility inputs for pipeline hazard exposure and cascading failure studies, and complements the Concawe oil pipeline statistics catalogued here.
